result_raw.result_text: In the uncontrolled pooled OLS model, never-high-school immigrants had an estimated 0.260 higher log wage gain than college-degree immigrants, equivalent to about 29.7% larger wage gains; this difference was statistically significant at p = 0.0372.

conclusion.conclusion_text: Task2 supports the focal claim because the never-high-school coefficient is positive and statistically significant.
